name: owid
description: Our World in Data — browse OWID charts, import a chart's data into the workspace (saved as a CSV under data/owid/), and get a starter Vega-Lite plot you can refine in the Plot tab or query in the Table tab. No API key and no install: pure HTTP against OWID's public grapher endpoints. The OWID tab accepts any chart slug or grapher URL, so the bundled starter catalogue isn't a ceiling.
